name: plzzz-bond
description: plzzz.bond — Meteora-powered Solana launchpad with one Bond it. mode. See docs/LIVE-DEPLOYMENT.md.

RPC_URL.description: Private HTTPS Solana RPC endpoint for the chosen network

PINATA_JWT.description: Pinata JWT restricted to the upload permissions needed by the app

POOL_CONFIG_KEY.description: Existing DBC pool config address on the chosen network

NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.description: Exact HTTPS app origin, e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com, without a trailing slash

SITE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Optional additional exact HTTPS origins, comma-separated; keep the canonical URL separate

ADMIN_KEY_HASH.description: Set privately with scripts/setup-admin.mjs; absent keeps the launchpad locked

ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET.description: Independent secret for launch receipt recovery and optional admin sessions; required for Bond it. launches

FEE_COLLECTOR_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Reviewed public fee collector address; keep its signing keys in the separate private signer.

LEGACY_POOL_CONFIG_KEYS.description: Optional comma-separated historical config addresses; never eligible for new launches.
